ai_summary: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Limited announced the allotment of 2,047 equity shares to eligible employees under its ESOP-2018, increasing the paid-up equity share capital by a minor amount. This routine transaction results in a negligible dilution of approximately 0.004% of the total shares outstanding. The issuance, compliant with SEBI regulations and aimed at employee incentivization, presents no material financial impacts or red flags for investors.
